title: Scaverim - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Scaverim in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - which character uses it, its element and scaling, and exactly where to get it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Scaverim is a dark-element weapon used by Lune. It scales with Vitality (B), Agility (C).

sections.title: How to Get the Scaverim
sections.content:
Location: Falling Leaves - defeat the Scavenger.

Obtained from Falling Leaves - defeat the Scavenger.

sections.title: Is the Scaverim Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Vitality (B), Agility (C). A dedicated dark pick - it belongs in a build already committed to that element.
